products.name: Besan Ladoo
products.description: Traditional sweet made with roasted gram flour and pure ghee
products.detailedDescription: A traditional Indian sweet made with roasted gram flour and pure ghee. Our Besan Ladoos are crafted using a generations-old recipe, where besan is carefully roasted to achieve the perfect golden color and nutty aroma. Each ladoo is hand-rolled to ensure perfect texture and consistency.
products.servingSuggestion: Best enjoyed with a glass of warm milk or as an evening snack.
products.storageInfo: Store in an airtight container. Stays fresh for up to 60 days at room temperature.

products.name: Green Moong Ladoo
products.description: Healthy and nutritious ladoo made with green moong dal
products.detailedDescription: A healthy twist on traditional ladoos, made with sprouted green moong dal and natural sweeteners. These ladoos are a perfect blend of taste and nutrition, making them an ideal healthy snack option for all age groups.
products.servingSuggestion: Perfect as a morning snack or post-workout energy boost.
products.storageInfo: Store in airtight container. Stays fresh for 30-45 days.

products.name: Dinka Ladoo
products.description: Special ladoo made with premium ingredients. No wheat flour, no sugar.
products.detailedDescription: Traditional winter special ladoos made with edible gum and dry fruits. These ladoos are particularly popular during winter months and are known for their warming properties and health benefits. Made without wheat flour or sugar, using organic jaggery.
products.servingSuggestion: Consume 1-2 ladoos daily during winter months.
products.storageInfo: Store in a cool, dry place. Stays fresh for up to 2 months.

products.name: Groundnut Ladoo
products.description: Nutritious ladoo made with roasted groundnuts
products.detailedDescription: A protein-rich sweet made with freshly roasted groundnuts and organic jaggery. Our groundnut ladoos are made in small batches to ensure freshness and maintain the perfect crunch of roasted peanuts.
products.servingSuggestion: Enjoy as a pre-workout snack or with evening tea.
products.storageInfo: Store in an airtight container. Best consumed within 20 days.

products.name: Rawa Ladoo
products.description: Delicate ladoo made with roasted semolina. No coconut.
products.detailedDescription: Light and delicious ladoos made with roasted semolina. These ladoos have a unique texture and are perfect for those who prefer lighter sweets. Made without coconut.
products.servingSuggestion: Best enjoyed with afternoon tea or as a light dessert.
products.storageInfo: Keep in airtight container. Fresh for up to 10 days.

products.name: Til (Sesame) Ladoo
products.description: Healthy ladoo made with roasted sesame seeds
products.detailedDescription: Traditional winter special ladoos made with roasted sesame seeds and jaggery. These ladoos are not just delicious but also packed with the goodness of sesame seeds and natural sweetness of jaggery.
products.servingSuggestion: Consume during winter mornings or evenings.
products.storageInfo: Stays fresh for up to 1 month when stored properly.

products.name: Ragi Ladoo
products.description: Nutritious ladoo made with finger millet flour
products.detailedDescription: Healthy and nutritious ladoos made with finger millet flour and enriched with dry fruits. These ladoos are a perfect combination of taste and health, especially beneficial for growing children and women.
products.servingSuggestion: Best consumed as breakfast or evening snack.
products.storageInfo: Store in cool, dry place. Stays fresh for up to 30 days.

products.name: Methi Ladoo
products.description: Healthy ladoo with fenugreek seeds and nutritious ingredients
products.detailedDescription: Traditional medicinal ladoos made with fenugreek seeds and wholesome ingredients including green moong powder, dinka, and halim. These ladoos are particularly beneficial for new mothers and those looking for health benefits along with taste.
products.servingSuggestion: Take 1-2 ladoos daily, preferably in the morning.
products.storageInfo: Keeps well for up to 1 month in airtight container.

products.name: Murmura Chivda
products.description: Crispy snack made with puffed rice
products.detailedDescription: A light and crunchy snack made with puffed rice and a perfect blend of spices. Our Murmura Chivda is made fresh in small batches to maintain its signature crunchiness and flavor.
products.servingSuggestion: Perfect with evening tea or as a light snack.
products.storageInfo: Stays crispy for up to 15 days in airtight container.

products.name: Avalakki Chivda
products.description: Flattened rice snack with nuts and spices
products.detailedDescription: A traditional South Indian snack made with flattened rice and a special blend of spices. Our Avalakki Chivda is known for its perfect balance of spices and crunchiness.
products.servingSuggestion: Can be enjoyed dry or mixed with onions and tomatoes.
products.storageInfo: Maintains freshness for up to 20 days when stored properly.

products.name: Chakli
products.description: Spiral-shaped crispy snack. No ghee, fried in cold pressed oil.
products.detailedDescription: A spiral-shaped crispy snack made with a perfect blend of rice flour and spices. Our Chaklis are hand-crafted to achieve the perfect spiral shape and crispiness that lasts longer. Fried in cold pressed oil.
products.servingSuggestion: Best enjoyed with hot tea or coffee.
products.storageInfo: Stays crispy for up to 1 month in airtight container.

products.name: Millets Laddo [Siridhanya]
products.description: Nutritious ladoo made with ancient siridhanya millets
products.detailedDescription: A superfood ladoo made with Siridhanya (ancient millets) that are known for their exceptional nutritional value. These ladoos are made with a blend of positive millets like foxtail, little, kodo, and barnyard millets combined with pure ghee and natural sweeteners.
products.servingSuggestion: Perfect for breakfast or as a healthy energy snack throughout the day.
products.storageInfo: Store in airtight container. Stays fresh for up to 45 days.

products.name: Sweet Shankarpali
products.detailedDescription: A traditional Maharashtrian sweet snack that's crispy and delicious. Sweet Shankarpali is made with refined flour, ghee, and sugar, deep-fried to golden perfection. These diamond-shaped delights are perfect for festivals and special occasions.
products.servingSuggestion: Enjoy with tea or coffee as an evening snack.
products.storageInfo: Stays crispy for up to 2 months in airtight container.

products.name: Salty Shankarpali
products.description: Crispy savory diamond-shaped snack with spices
products.detailedDescription: A savory version of the traditional Shankarpali, seasoned with the perfect blend of spices. These crispy, diamond-shaped bites are addictively crunchy and make for an excellent tea-time companion or party snack.
products.servingSuggestion: Best enjoyed with hot tea or as a standalone snack.
products.storageInfo: Maintains crispiness for up to 2 months in airtight container.

products.name: Sweet Chirote
products.description: Delicate layered sweet pastry, a festive specialty
products.detailedDescription: Sweet Chirote is a traditional Maharashtrian delicacy with multiple crispy layers, dusted with powdered sugar. This delicate pastry requires skill and patience to make, resulting in a melt-in-mouth texture that's simply irresistible.
products.servingSuggestion: Serve as a special dessert or with evening tea.
products.storageInfo: Stays fresh and crispy for up to 1.5 months in airtight container.

products.name: Salty Chirote
products.description: Crispy layered savory pastry with aromatic spices
products.detailedDescription: A savory twist to the traditional Chirote, featuring multiple flaky layers infused with aromatic spices. This delicate pastry combines the perfect balance of crispy texture and savory flavors, making it an irresistible snack.
products.servingSuggestion: Perfect accompaniment with tea, coffee, or as a standalone snack.
products.storageInfo: Retains crispiness for up to 1.5 months in airtight container.
